visualCharacteristics.purpose: Row of video cards: poster image with a play button that loads the video inline
visualCharacteristics.layout: 1 column mobile, 2 at 600px, 3 at 900px; 16:9 poster with play button overlay

contentPattern.structure: cell 1: poster image; cell 2: optional heading/text plus the video link (YouTube, Vimeo, Dynamic Media /is/content/ or .mp4). The link text becomes the play button accessible label
contentPattern.sourceDescription: Three look-alike illustrated video items in a row (poster + Dynamic Media video link each)

usage: Small-wins video row on the home page.
reuseGuidance: Use for any group of videos with posters. Without a recognised video link the card renders as an image card.
